title: Database
description: packages.db in an instance file. May be overridden in config.local.json, the setup writes there.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: main is the database of the project. Any other is opened when it is first used, and a failure there does not take the site down.

propertyNames.description: A name: letters and digits, starting lower case.

driver.title: Engine
driver.description: mysql for MySQL and MariaDB, pgsql for PostgreSQL.

host.title: Host
host.description: The database server: a name or an IP, localhost on the same machine.

port.title: Port
port.description: Empty: the default port of the engine (mysql 3306, pgsql 5432).

name.title: Database
name.description: The name of the database on the server. A new connection starts with its own name.

user.title: User
user.description: The user the connection signs in with. Its password lies in config.local.json of the machine.

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: The character set of the connection. mysql only.

bindOnlyUsedParams.title: Bind only used parameters
bindOnlyUsedParams.description: Binds only the parameters a query uses. Not set: on from PHP 8.4.
